PoetryLines: Eleven months of Peace and Oases
Of Cyclic Lightning and Cloudsea Depths
Question the Mistake of a Veteran
One "Old Master of Racing" of Five
By Fiilo of the Mephora's Eyes
Cranes and Sketched Towers don't care
Keeper, Keeper, give me your cane
I want to be the same
I just want to be the same
Air of a different taste than the outside
Tiny World of empowered Sketchpad Design
A room full of just myself
Slide shyly in front of walls
Datapoints on a world so far away
The Glass here is more Glassy
Didn't even notice I could see the outside
All the Mundane, sprouts All the Sacred
Compressure Now Too Strong in This Space!
Nestled in a tiny mountain town
The first Penturans, Urnh as home
Enormous harps struck by forked mallets
performed by three players as One
Rigid Lines give way to Peace
At the end of Our Street
Great Lighthouse on The Great Coast
She watches over Cloud Ocean shore
To reach Holy Zenith of Storm
